threads.body: The phrase “as if it was observed by the caller” is awkward and slightly changes the meaning. This entry should match the doc wording (“as observed by the caller”).
threads.hunk:
@@ -31,3 +31,7 @@
   ([#136](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/pull/136))
 
 ### 📚 Clarifications 📚
+
+- Clarify that a GenAI span SHOULD cover the duration of the corresponding call
+  as if it was observed by the caller, including any retries.

replies.body: Addressed in c0ee217 — matched the CHANGELOG wording to the doc.

threads.body: Wording is a bit ungrammatical/unclear: the issue doesn’t get retried; the operation/request does. Rephrasing improves readability and avoids ambiguity about what is being retried.
threads.hunk:
@@ -24,6 +24,15 @@ linkTitle: Spans
 
 ## Spans
 
+GenAI spans represent logical operations as observed by the caller.
+They SHOULD cover the duration of the operation, starting when it is
+initiated and ending when the response is fully received or the operation
+is terminated due to an error or cancellation.
+
+If a transient issue happened and was retried within the operation, the
+corresponding span SHOULD cover the duration of the logical operation with
+all retries.

replies.body: Addressed in 6204aec — reworded to "If a transient issue happened and the request was retried automatically, the corresponding span SHOULD cover the duration of the logical operation with all retries."
